newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo city to sell 19.8 pct stake in Comgas.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo city to sell 19.8 pct stake in Comgas.

text.p: Sao Paulo's municipal government on Wednesday will sell its 19.86 percent voting stake in state-owned natural gas distributor Comgas, Comgas said in a statement published in local newspapers.
The municipal government will offer 1.7 billion Comgas common shares at an auction on the Sao Paulo stock exchange at 1700 local/1900 gmt, it said.
The minimum price for the 1.7 billion common shares was set at 74 million reais ($71 million), or 43.289 reais per lot of 1,000 shares, the statement said.
Banco do Brasil brokerage BB DTVM and Brazilian banks Garantia and Banespa will coordinate the sale, it said.
Comgas, which is expected to be privatized in October, is controlled by the Sao Paulo state government which holds an 80 percent stake in the firm.
Comgas distributes 3 million cubic meters of gas daily but it has agreed with Petrobras to increase its daily purchases by 1.5 million cubic meters of gas by 1998 and another 4 million daily by 1999.
